name: MerkleClaimBudget
description: Budget. Pays cumulative Merkle allocations: each account claims what it is owed, and the flow's root receives exactly that amount. Only the account can claim; it picks the payout address in the TransferToBeneficiaryAction node's data. The trigger's budget data is abi.encode(account, cumulative, proof). Records claims through the DAO: it requires RECORD_CLAIM_PERMISSION_ID for the DAO, which the setup grants. setRoot needs SET_SETTINGS_PERMISSION_ID.

settings.name: token
settings.description: The token the claims are paid in.

settings.name: root
settings.description: Merkle root of (account, cumulative amount) leaves, OpenZeppelin StandardMerkleTree format.
